say:2:1321723101:1.text:
Are you... a templar knight?
Has Whiteridge fallen so far as to require templar knights for suppression?
say:2:1321723101:1.source_cn: 你是圣骑士……？\n白山公国已经需要圣骑士来镇压了吗。

say:3:1321723102:1.text: You... are you from the Valesa family? To think you're still around...
say:3:1321723102:1.source_cn: 你……你就是瓦勒沙大公的先祖？

say:4:1321723103:1.text: Your expression—I've seen it countless times. Surprise. Disbelief. It's always the same when someone first lays eyes on me.
say:4:1321723103:1.source_cn: 和许多第一次见到我的人表情一样，你的表情也写满讶异。

say:5:1321723104:1.text: I thought the Temple molded templar knights' hearts into unyielding steel, untouched by sentiment.
say:5:1321723104:1.source_cn: 我还以为圣堂已经将圣骑士的心锤炼得宛如钢铁，不会再有丝...

say:6:1321723105:1.text: Then you have misunderstood the Temple. Our hearts are guided by faith, not dulled by it.
say:6:1321723105:1.source_cn: 那么，你一定对圣堂有所误解。

say:7:1321723106:0.text: I've misunderstood nothing, just as you misunderstand nothing about me. Do not trouble yourself with pity for my untimely death—I have no use for the Temple's sympathy.
say:7:1321723106:0.source_cn: 我没有。正如你也没有误解我。所以免去嗟叹我的早逝吧，我...

say:8:1321723107:1.text: Now, enough of these pleasantries. What brings you to my presence today?
say:8:1321723107:1.source_cn: 那么，寒暄过后……你们今天所来又是为了什么呢？
say:8:1321723107:1.male: Now, enough of these pleasantries. What brings you to my presence today?
say:8:1321723107:1.female: Now, enough of these pleasantries. What brings you to my presence today?

choice_prompt:9:1321723107.text: Now, enough of these pleasantries. What brings you to my presence today?
choice_prompt:9:1321723107.source_cn: 那么，寒暄过后……你们今天所来又是为了什么呢？
choice_prompt:9:1321723107.male: Now, enough of these pleasantries. What brings you to my presence today?
choice_prompt:9:1321723107.female: Now, enough of these pleasantries. What brings you to my presence today?

say:10:1321723110:1.text: Another funeral for the Valesa family... I never thought I'd attend one again.
say:10:1321723110:1.source_cn: 又是瓦勒沙家族的葬礼……呵，我以为我不会再参加了。

say:11:1321723111:1.text: Yet, since you've extended the courtesy of inviting me, and the Temple permits the Graveborn to attend... I will come.
say:11:1321723111:1.source_cn: 但既然你们特意邀请，圣堂也不介意亡灵的出现……我会出席。
say:11:1321723111:1.male: Yet, since you've extended the courtesy of inviting me, and the Temple permits the Graveborn to attend... I will come.
say:11:1321723111:1.female: Yet, since you've extended the courtesy of inviting me, and the Temple permits the Graveborn to attend... I will come.

choice_prompt:12:1321723111.text: Yet, since you've extended the courtesy of inviting me, and the Temple permits the Graveborn to attend... I will come.
choice_prompt:12:1321723111.source_cn: 但既然你们特意邀请，圣堂也不介意亡灵的出现……我会出席。
choice_prompt:12:1321723111.male: Yet, since you've extended the courtesy of inviting me, and the Temple permits the Graveborn to attend... I will come.
choice_prompt:12:1321723111.female: Yet, since you've extended the courtesy of inviting me, and the Temple permits the Graveborn to attend... I will come.

say:13:1321723112:1.text: I'll send someone to fetch her.
say:13:1321723112:1.male: I'll send someone to fetch her.
say:13:1321723112:1.female: I'll send someone to fetch her.

narration:15:1321723114:0.text: Shortly after, Valka arrives at Everstill Manor, escorted by Ludovic's attendant.
narration:15:1321723114:0.source_cn: 没过多久，瓦丽卡跟随柳博米尔的侍从来到了永寂庄园

say:20:1321723115:1.text: Valka, you're here! We've been waiting forever!
say:20:1321723115:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你总算来了！我们等了你好久！

say:21:1321723116:1.text: What's the matter? Ludovic sent for me, claiming it was urgent.
say:21:1321723116:1.source_cn: 出什么事了？柳博米尔派人来找我，只说有急事。
say:21:1321723116:1.male: What's the matter? Ludovic sent for me, claiming it was urgent.
say:21:1321723116:1.female: What's the matter? Ludovic sent for me, claiming it was urgent.

choice_prompt:22:1321723116.text: What's the matter? Ludovic sent for me, claiming it was urgent.
choice_prompt:22:1321723116.source_cn: 出什么事了？柳博米尔派人来找我，只说有急事。
choice_prompt:22:1321723116.male: What's the matter? Ludovic sent for me, claiming it was urgent.
choice_prompt:22:1321723116.female: What's the matter? Ludovic sent for me, claiming it was urgent.

say:23:1321723117:1.text: Ah... a funeral for the princess?
say:23:1321723117:1.male: Ah... a funeral for the princess?
say:23:1321723117:1.female: Ah... a funeral for the princess?

say:28:1321723119:1.text: Sigmund Valesa... the Archduke who met his tragic end during the Frost Furie incident. The Temple is arranging his funeral as well.
say:28:1321723119:1.source_cn: 齐格蒙德·瓦勒沙，在冰之恶魔事件中不幸逝世的大公阁下，...

say:29:1321723120:1.text: I see... I will be there.
say:29:1321723120:1.source_cn: 我明白了……我会准时出席。

say:30:1321723121:1.text: The funeral will take place in three days. Your generosity honors the departed—may the goddess' blessings shine upon you both.
say:30:1321723121:1.source_cn: 葬礼将在三天后举办。感谢两位的慷慨，愿女神庇佑你们。

say:31:1321723122:1.text: Your blessings are noted, but we no longer have need of Dura's light. The dead have no need for breath or life.
say:31:1321723122:1.source_cn: 谢谢，但我们不需要艾雅，已死之人不需要生命的吐息。

say:32:1321723123:1.text: Where will Sigmund and Yolena rest until the funeral? Valesa Castle or Whiteridge Temple?
say:32:1321723123:1.source_cn: 葬礼前这三天，齐格蒙德和亚莲娜将在哪里停灵？瓦勒沙城堡...
say:32:1321723123:1.male: Where will Sigmund and Yolena rest until the funeral? Valesa Castle or Whiteridge Temple?
say:32:1321723123:1.female: Where will Sigmund and Yolena rest until the funeral? Valesa Castle or Whiteridge Temple?

choice_prompt:33:1321723123.text: Where will Sigmund and Yolena rest until the funeral? Valesa Castle or Whiteridge Temple?
choice_prompt:33:1321723123.source_cn: 葬礼前这三天，齐格蒙德和亚莲娜将在哪里停灵？瓦勒沙城堡，还是白山大教堂？
choice_prompt:33:1321723123.male: Where will Sigmund and Yolena rest until the funeral? Valesa Castle or Whiteridge Temple?
choice_prompt:33:1321723123.female: Where will Sigmund and Yolena rest until the funeral? Valesa Castle or Whiteridge Temple?

say:34:1321723124:1.text: So, all that remains of the Valesa family is the holy light of Dura shining upon snow-covered ruins... How fitting...
say:34:1321723124:1.source_cn: 一切都已经覆灭，只有艾雅的圣光矗立在白雪之中吗？呵……
say:34:1321723124:1.male: So, all that remains of the Valesa family is the holy light of Dura shining upon snow-covered ruins... How fitting...
say:34:1321723124:1.female: So, all that remains of the Valesa family is the holy light of Dura shining upon snow-covered ruins... How fitting...

say:35:1321723126:1.text: The Valesa branch of the Duchy of Whiteridge is no more. I shall go early to keep vigil for Sigmund and Yolena.
say:35:1321723126:1.source_cn: 瓦勒沙家族在白山公国的这一脉已经完全覆灭了。我会提早过...

say:36:1321723127:1.text: Whatever has come to pass, I remain a part of the Valesa bloodline—that will never change. It is my duty to bid farewell to this once-glorious legacy.
say:36:1321723127:1.source_cn: 无论如何，我曾是瓦勒沙的血脉，这一点永远不会改变。我也...

say:37:1321723128:1.text: I will accompany you. The Valesa family were once my comrades-in-arms; I owe them my respect.
say:37:1321723128:1.source_cn: 我陪你一起去。瓦勒沙家族也曾经是我的战友。

say:39:1321723130:1.text: I pray she may find the peace that eluded her in life.
say:39:1321723130:1.source_cn: 我希望她能获得真正的安息。

say:40:1321723131:1.text: Rest assured, the goddess shall cradle them in her eternal light.
say:40:1321723131:1.source_cn: 他们一定会在女神的怀抱中获得安宁。

say:41:1321723132:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I must <style="highlight">return to the castle</style> to assist Captain Rodrigo with the preparations. We will take our leave now.
say:41:1321723132:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I must <style="highlight">return to the castle</style> to assist Captain Rodrigo with the preparations. We will take our leave now.
say:41:1321723132:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I must <style="highlight">return to the castle</style> to assist Captain Rodrigo with the preparations. We will take our leave now.

say:42:1321723133:1.text: ...May the radiance of the goddess guide and protect us all.

say:44:1321723125:1.text: When the Valesa family reaches its twilight, even their grand castle fades, vanishing like smoke in the wind...
say:44:1321723125:1.source_cn: 当瓦勒沙家族走向末路，恢弘的城堡也会随风而逝……
say:44:1321723125:1.male: When the Valesa family reaches its twilight, even their grand castle fades, vanishing like smoke in the wind...
say:44:1321723125:1.female: When the Valesa family reaches its twilight, even their grand castle fades, vanishing like smoke in the wind...

choice:33:1:2.text: The castle has yet to be rebuilt.
choice:33:1:2.male: The castle has yet to be rebuilt.
choice:33:1:2.female: The castle has yet to be rebuilt.

choice:22:1:2.text: A funeral is urgent enough, no?
choice:22:1:2.male: A funeral is urgent enough, no?
choice:22:1:2.female: A funeral is urgent enough, no?

choice:12:0:1.text: Do you know where Valka is?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 你有办法联系瓦丽卡吗？
choice:12:0:1.male: Do you know where Valka is?
choice:12:0:1.female: Do you know where Valka is?

choice:12:1:2.text: We also need to invite her.
choice:12:1:2.male: We also need to invite her.
choice:12:1:2.female: We also need to invite her.

choice:9:0:1.text: To invite you to a funeral.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 为了邀请你参加大公和亚莲娜的葬礼
choice:9:0:1.male: To invite you to a funeral.
choice:9:0:1.female: To invite you to a funeral.

say:45:1321723108:1.text: Clearly, making grim jests comes more naturally to you than wielding magic.
say:45:1321723108:1.source_cn: 显然，讲冷笑话比当魔法师更适合你。
say:45:1321723108:1.male: Clearly, making grim jests comes more naturally to you than wielding magic.
say:45:1321723108:1.female: Clearly, making grim jests comes more naturally to you than wielding magic.

say:46:1321723109:1.text: The Captain of the Palace Guard and the Temple's acolytes are arranging the funerals of Archduke Valesa and Princess Yolena. They greatly hope for your presence.
say:46:1321723109:1.source_cn: 是宫廷侍卫长和修道院的修士们正在筹备瓦勒沙大公与亚莲娜...

choice:9:1:2.text: To ask you to become Archduke.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 你该去继承大公之位了
choice:9:1:2.male: To ask you to become Archduke.
choice:9:1:2.female: To ask you to become Archduke.
